## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant synthetic tests pass.
- [ ] Changed setup or behavior is documented.
- [ ] No real profile data, identifiers, screenshots/logs, local state or signing material is included.
- [ ] Live-device claims are distinguished from synthetic evidence.
- [ ] Stop conditions, explicit live start and loopback boundaries remain intact.

For a docs-only change, list the links/examples you checked instead of inventing tests.
